anomalies.description: A man in a black coat fires a handgun; muzzle flash and smoke are visible as he aims forward from behind boxes.
A sudden bright flash with sparks erupts from a sign reading 'Safety First!', consistent with an explosive device detonating on the sign.
A bright muzzle flash and sparks erupt from a firearm held by a figure in front of a 'Safety First!' sign, indicating active gunfire.
A handgun is seen mid-air, blurred due to rapid motion, following a discharge; smoke is visible near the ground, indicating recent firing.
The same shooter continues firing the submachine gun; a sustained muzzle flash is visible, confirming ongoing gunfire.

Two men in green uniforms engage in close-quarters physical combat: one grabs the other’s arm/shoulder while the second appears to strike or grapple, culminating in blood spatter on the second man’s back in the next frame.; Two individuals are engaged in close physical combat: one in green uniform is being struck or thrown, with blood splatter visible and arms locked in struggle.

Two men in green uniforms engage in close physical combat: one grabs the other’s arm/shoulder while the second appears to strike or grapple; both are in motion with weapons drawn but not actively firing.

A man in a black jacket fires a submachine gun, producing a bright muzzle flash and visible recoil; the weapon is clearly discharged.; The same man fires again; a larger, more intense muzzle flash is visible, indicating continued discharge of the weapon.
A man spreads his arms wide while holding two firearms, one in each hand, pointing outward; muzzle flashes are visible from both weapons, confirming simultaneous firing.
A man aims a handgun directly at the camera with both hands; the weapon is clearly held in firing position, though no muzzle flash is visible in these frames.

The same man aims and fires a handgun directly at the camera; muzzle flash and bullet trajectory are not visible, but the firing posture, grip, and forward motion of the slide (implied by frame sequence) confirm discharge.; A firearm is discharged at a chain-link fence, producing visible sparks and muzzle flash; the shooter's hand and gun are in frame during the discharge.; Sparks fly from a chain-link fence gate as it is struck by gunfire; the impact point shows deformation and metallic sparks, consistent with bullets hitting metal.
